suggestions.name: Image filter
suggestions.description: Explore different styles of your images
suggestions.prompt: Make an image filter app that has a central image preview with a carousel of filter options such as grayscale, soft focus, invert, hue shift, and more. A right panel should display the name of the filter selected along with a single slider that pertains to filter intensity or color hue target etc.

suggestions.name: Voice over
suggestions.description: Record your voice over a video
suggestions.prompt: Create a minimalist voiceover studio app that uses deep blacks, monospace typography, and red accents. The interface should feature a main media preview area for imported videos or images, sitting above a sleek, zoomable two-track timeline for media and voice. Users can scrub the timeline with a precise playhead and use a prominent record button to capture microphone audio, which instantly appears as a synced clip on the voice track. To ensure clean recordings, the app must automatically mute existing audio while recording, and users should be able to easily delete unwanted clips directly from the timeline. Add a button to export to media grid and a button to download clip

suggestions.name: Time stretcher
suggestions.description: Change video frame rate and clip speed
suggestions.prompt: Build a simple video manipulation tool called 'TimeStretch' that allows users to upload a video and manipulate its playback in real-time. The interface should feature a professional workspace layout with a large video viewport on the left and a dedicated controls panel on the right. Key features must include a live playback speed slider (0.1x to 10.0x), a custom frame rate slider (1 fps to 60 fps) that visually creates a stop-motion effect, and an interactive timeline below the video that allows users to scrub through the footage and drag handles to trim the start and end points of the looping clip. The aesthetic should be minimal, subtle gray borders, technical uppercase typography for labels, and monospace fonts for values. There should be an export video to grid button, that exports the stretched video to the media grid.

suggestions.name: Style morph
suggestions.description: Use preset styles to reimagine your image
suggestions.prompt: Create an app where I can pick an image from my gallery, apply a style transfer (e.g., "oil painting" or "anime" + several more) with nano banana. Show the result in a before and after comparison with a slider that reveals the new image underneath the original. Keep the generations handy as I explore other versions so I can go back and forth.
